Rowlet

Grass Flying

Alola · Generation 7

Rowlet is a Grass/Flying-type Grass Quill Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 1.5 kg. It evolves into Dartrix. Its highest base stat is HP (68), with a base stat total of 320.
